app.name: 3z Prod
splash.loading: One sec, getting your day ready…
hdr.hello: Hey 3z! What are we learning today?
hdr.freezesHint: Miss a day and a freeze saves your streak
flow.title: 🧭 Today's flow
flow.sub: Just 3 steps. Everything else is under “More for today”
flow.step3Wait: Finish both steps to light your flame 🔥
flow.step3Done: 🔥 Day complete! Your flame is at {n} days
flow.allDone: No quest available right now: you finished everything your gear allows! 🎉 Add gear in Settings, or do the 5-minute task.
more.title: ➕ More for today
more.sub: Other quests if you have time
skills.title: Skills
skills.sub: 6 pillars, and every program is an island. Finish a skill's 4 quests to master it ⭐
sheet.lp1: A full tutorial to learn it step by step
sheet.lp2: A written guide to check while you work
sheet.lp3: Short clips: ideas and how others use it
sheet.tapHint: Tap a quest to tick it, tap again to undo
sheet.proofPh: Link to the video or article
toast.daySmall: Flame at {n} days · see you tomorrow
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Everything here is saved on your phone
settings.soundDesc: 8-bit sounds when you finish a quest or level up
settings.reminderNote: Reminders arrive when sync is added
settings.gearNote: Adding the camera unlocks locked skills 🔓
settings.dataNote: Progress is stored on this device until sync is added. Export it now and then as a backup.
settings.importConfirm: This replaces all your current progress with the file. Sure?
settings.importErr: That file isn't a valid progress file.
settings.resetConfirm: This erases all XP, quests and your streak. There's no undo unless you have an export. Sure?
avatar.title: 🧑‍🎨 Your look
avatar.note: Style your mini-you. Ranks still unlock the rest of the gear on their own.
morePage.title: More
research.errQuota: Daily quota used up. Try again tomorrow.
research.errForbidden: This key can't be used here. Check its restrictions in Google Cloud.
research.errNetwork: Couldn't reach YouTube. Check your connection.
research.errUnknown: Something went wrong with the search.
research.pasteUrlPh: Paste a TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or web link
research.pasteErr: That doesn't look like a valid link.
discover.title: Discover
discover.sub: Type a topic and scrub YouTube, TikTok and Instagram for it.
settings.apiYoutubeHelp: Free from Google Cloud: enable “YouTube Data API v3”, then restrict the key to your site's address (HTTP referrer) so nobody else can use it. It stays on this device only.
research.scoutNotConfigured: Connect the Scout Worker to see TikTok and Instagram here.
research.scoutUsage: ~{n} searches from this device this month (limit {max}, shared with the Trend Radar)
research.scoutErrQuota: This month's free searches are used up (or it's busy). Try again later.
research.scoutErrAuth: The Scout Worker refused the token, or its Tavily key is wrong. Check Settings.
research.scoutErrNetwork: Couldn't reach the Scout Worker. Check your connection.
research.scoutErrUpstream: The search service had a problem. Try again in a bit.
research.ytViaScout: From the Scout Worker (add a YouTube key for richer results).
settings.apiScoutUrlHelp: The address of your Scout Worker, shown in Cloudflare after the deploy workflow runs. It brings TikTok and Instagram results into Research and Discover.
settings.apiScoutTokenPh: The SCOUT_TOKEN you set on GitHub
settings.apiScoutTokenHelp: The same random string you saved as the SCOUT_TOKEN repository secret. It stays on this device only.
settings.scoutErrNoUrl: Add a valid Scout Worker URL first.
settings.scoutErrNoTavily: The Worker answers, but its TAVILY_API_KEY secret is missing.
research.hintToggle: Add the program name to the search
research.lenNeedsKey: The length filter only works with a YouTube Data API key.
research.noneYt: No YouTube videos for this topic
research.noneTt: No TikTok videos for this topic
research.noneIg: No Instagram posts for this topic
research.empty: Nothing turned up 🙈 Try other words, drop a filter, or search on the platform itself:
research.emptySaved: Nothing attached here yet. Attach something from the results and it shows up here.
research.enableYt: To see YouTube results here, add a YouTube Data API key or connect the Scout Worker.
research.startTyping: Type a topic above and hit Search 👆
settings.accounts.title: 🔗 Connected accounts
settings.accounts.needWorker: Add the Scout Worker URL and token under “API keys” above, then connect TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Threads from here.
settings.accounts.explainer: Once an account is connected, the Worker pulls followers, views, engagement, your latest posts and your audience once a day at 6 am, and the dashboard reads them when you open it. Tokens stay in the Worker and never reach your phone.
settings.accounts.state.notConfigured: Not set up in the Worker yet
settings.accounts.state.error: Last sync failed ({reason}), reconnect if it repeats
settings.accounts.disconnectBody: The {platform} token is removed from the Worker and syncing stops. Your past numbers stay here.
settings.accounts.removeSeedNote: The Sep 27, 2026 Beacons snapshot is still in Social Analytics. Once your accounts are connected you do not need it.
settings.accounts.removeSeedBody: Removes the Sep 27, 2026 snapshot and the audience breakdowns that came from Beacons. They do not come back; your live and manual numbers are untouched.
settings.accounts.err.unconfigured: Add the Scout Worker URL and token first.
settings.accounts.err.auth: The Worker refused the token. Check the API keys.
settings.accounts.err.network: Could not reach the Worker. Check your connection.
settings.accounts.err.notConfigured: This platform is not set up in the Worker yet.
settings.accounts.err.notConnected: The platform is not connected. Press “Connect” first.
settings.accounts.err.state: The connect link expired. Try again.
settings.accounts.err.exchange: The platform did not accept the connection. Try again.
settings.accounts.err.upstream: The platform has a problem right now. Try again later.
settings.accounts.err.rateLimited: The platform asked us to slow down. Try again later.
settings.accounts.err.badRequest: Bad request to the Worker. Refresh the page and retry.
notes.title: 📝 Notes
notes.sub: One note per skill, sorted like your skill tree. Write your research here, no need to leave for Obsidian.
notes.pick: Pick a skill from the tree to open its note.
notes.tickHint: Write something in the note first
notes.placeholder: Write here… Markdown works: # heading, - bullet, **bold**, and [[skill name]] to link another note.
notes.emptyRead: This note is empty. Tap Write to start.
notes.backlinksNone: No note links here yet. Type [[{name}]] in another note.
notes.livePh: Your note shows up here, formatted, as you type.
notes.imageMissing: This image isn't saved on this device
notes.graphEmpty: The graph fills in as you write notes. Link them with [[skill name]] and the threads show up here.
notes.graphHint: Each dot is a skill; the squares are their islands on the map. A gold line is a note linking a note. Tap any dot to open its note.
